title: Closed accounts
statementMd:
How many accounts are closed (`closed = 1`)?

Expected columns: `closed_accounts`.

Tables: `customers`, `accounts`, `transactions`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT COUNT(*) AS closed_accounts FROM accounts WHERE closed = 1;
```
